## Hire Candidate (HC)

The single writer for the candidate → employee transition. Requires an ACCEPTED offer; creates the Employee from the candidate’s identity plus the offer’s terms (role, salary, start date, status onboarding), stamps the candidate `hired` with a local-calendar decision date. Pipeline stage and permanent record can never disagree because one command writes both.

### Example

Natural target: the linked candidate Jon Ferreira, whose offer is accepted and who is ready to hire.

### Non-goals

No onboarding checklist creation (the existing CreateOnboardingChecklistCommand owns that). No equipment/accounts provisioning.

cardInfo.name: Hire Candidate
cardInfo.summary: Accepted offer → Employee record + candidate stamped hired, in one write.
